propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md incorrectly state that --force on transition and claim commands is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP, contradicting the shipped MCP surface and the 2026-08-18 ruling that allows force on all surfaces.

The audit model for force-flagged writes relies on the absence of a signed attestation rather than withholding capability from MCP, and CI pipelines enforce certification by checking for that absence.
The MCP docstrings in _mcp_writes.py for transition_ticket and claim_ticket were already corrected to reflect reason-bearing force parameters; the canonical prose documentation has not caught up.
Documentation must be rewritten to state that force is available on library, CLI, and MCP surfaces, with audit enforced through absent attestation and optional CI certification gates.
